# katapult_disk (Data Source)

Retrieves a disk and its current Virtual Machine assignment observations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing disk by ID.
data "katapult_disk" "database" {
  id = "disk_2YvW3Z8kQm5nL7pR"
}

# Inspect whether the disk is currently assigned and attached.
output "database_disk_assignment" {
  value = {
    virtual_machine_id = data.katapult_disk.database.virtual_machine_id
    attach_on_boot     = data.katapult_disk.database.attach_on_boot
    attachment_state   = data.katapult_disk.database.attachment_state
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the disk.

### Read-Only

- `attach_on_boot` (Boolean) Observed attach-on-boot policy, or null when unassigned.
- `attachment_state` (String) Observed physical attachment state, or null when unassigned.
- `boot` (Boolean) Whether this is the assigned Virtual Machine's boot disk, or null when unassigned.
- `bus_type` (String) Bus type of the disk.
- `data_center_id` (String) The ID of the data center containing the disk.
- `data_center_name` (String) The name of the data center containing the disk.
- `data_center_permalink` (String) The permalink of the data center containing the disk.
- `io_profile_id` (String) The ID of the I/O profile applied to the disk.
- `name` (String) The name of the disk.
- `size_in_gb` (Number) Size of the disk in GB.
- `state` (String) Current state of the disk.
- `storage_speed` (String) Storage speed of the disk.
- `virtual_machine_fqdn` (String) The FQDN of the assigned Virtual Machine, or null when unassigned.
- `virtual_machine_id` (String) The ID of the assigned Virtual Machine, or null when unassigned.
- `wwn` (String) World Wide Name identifier of the disk.
